log-entry.title: Open questions at the Phase 1 gate (packet )

body.p: For the owner. Only the first blocks a gate box.

item.p: CI billing. GitHub Actions refuses every job ("recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased"). Restore billing (or move CI elsewhere) so the two CI gate boxes can be ticked and macOS, Windows and MSVC are built again; until then those platforms are unverified since the Phase 0 gate.
Phase 2 may start with the CI boxes open? The review ran every check locally (); CLAUDE.md is the orchestrator's to move to Phase 2.
Substrate freeze (). Accept the rule: additive changes with a record, no changes to existing declarations without reopening .

The 510 "error" outcomes of XP40 are mostly unlowered constructs (UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE, 493); 8 hit LIMIT_EXCEEDED and 7 the 512 MiB budget of the driver. asks for zero at the Phase 2 gate; the 15 resource cases need a look in Phase 2 (2.19 sweeps).
Size budget in CI. 's budget is not enforced by a test; 1.23b grew the wasm CLI by 55 KB unnoticed. Add the size check to CMake or ci.yml in Phase 2 (2.0 owns the root CMakeLists.txt).
